scope: Read-only review of incoming Zotero engine diff, corresponding boundary/recovery tests, and local documented preservation/refusal contract; root subsequently authorized the bounded two-file correction and focused regressions.

findings.status: fixed and focused regression verified; broader acceptance owned by root
findings.summary: Empty instruction-side run properties could become visible citation or bibliography result formatting.
findings.cause: The incoming classifier admits empty formatted code runs. propsAt returns the last WmlRun properties when the requested offset is at paragraph end, so a field without cache runs acquired its empty code run color/font/weight.
findings.observedBaseline: Six independent paths produced code-only red FF0000 instead of explicit context123456/default000000: metadata citation update, native plain citation, native rich citation, native unlink with replacement text, native bibliography, native unlink bibliography.
findings.fix: Seven existing-field formatting-selection sites use a local helper. It excludes only recorded empty code runs from a read-only paragraph view, including adjacent complete Zotero fields sharing an empty text offset, then reuses propsAt with the original offset. Source metadata and the live paragraph remain untouched.
findings.preservationControls: Existing non-empty result style, following visible context fallback, and adjacent empty citation all pass; cases check live and DOCX save/reopen behavior.

reviewChecks: Bounded direct run-property whitelist rejects unknown, style/theme/revision/hidden/nested state, invalid values, and contradictory duplicates.

WordFieldSpans empty-run structural relaxation still requires native packet canEdit eligibility.
